text: The W-type W(A, B) (well-founded tree) is used to encode:
choices: general recursive types and inductive families
explanation: W-types encode inductive types in pure MLTT: W(A,B) has constructor sup(a, f) where a:A is a label and f:B(a)→W(A,B) gives subtrees. ℕ = W(Bool, rec Bool (λ_. ⊥) (λ_. 1)).
